title: Shadow Theory and the Wilson Yang–Mills Construction: A Source–Readout Reconstruction
headline: Recovering Yang–Mills through Shadow Theory.
description: Shadow Theory constructs a connected realization of the Wilson Yang–Mills argument: its configurations, measures, effective quantities, physical fields and operator correlations, with explicit recovery maps and compatible operations throughout.
subtitle: Shadow Theory constructs a connected realization of the Wilson Yang–Mills argument: its configurations, measures, effective quantities, physical fields and operator correlations, with explicit recovery maps and compatible operations throughout.
author: Jeremy Rodgers

title: A Wilson Yang–Mills Construction: A Natural-Language Mathematical Exposition
headline: The Wilson construction, developed in full.
description: Follow the mathematical construction from finite Wilson measures through calibrated continuum limits, physical fields and Wightman reconstruction to operator products and the centered trace. A standalone companion to the Shadow Theory reconstruction.
subtitle: Follow the mathematical construction from finite Wilson measures through calibrated continuum limits, physical fields and Wightman reconstruction to operator products and the centered trace. A standalone companion to the Shadow Theory reconstruction.
author: Jeremy Rodgers
